description: This test file contains unit tests for the message-channel module, focusing on functions that resolve message channels from strings, handle plugin aliasing, and check markdown capabilities based on plugin metadata. It uses Vitest for testing and imports various functions and types from other modules within the project.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test case by resetting the active plugin registry.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleans up after each test case by resetting the plugin registry.

methods.name: resolveGatewayMessageChannel
methods.description: Resolves a string identifier to a standardized message channel name; used in tests to verify correct normalization.

methods.name: isMarkdownCapableMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a message channel supports Markdown based on plugin metadata.
